# Test images

`face.jpg` is a resized NASA photograph of Eileen Collins, image identifier S90-45845. It is used only to verify face detection and opaque masking. It is not product artwork or an endorsement.

Source [NASA profile](https://www.nasa.gov/former-astronaut-eileen-collins/) and [original image](https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/S90-45845/S90-45845~large.jpg?crop=faces%2Cfocalpoint&fit=clip&h=1246&w=1920).

NASA makes its imagery available for factual educational and informational use under its [media usage guidelines](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/). Credit NASA. The downloaded photograph was resized to a maximum dimension of 512 pixels with macOS `sips`.
